rubric.name: Attention Fragmentation
rubric.description: Frequency of rapid cuts or pacing that may signal synthetic narration.

anchors.low: Pacing is natural, few abrupt transitions.
anchors.medium: Occasional quick cuts, but overall natural.
anchors.high: Frequent rapid cuts, indicating automated editing.

rubric.name: Substance Deficit
rubric.description: Presence of filler content or lack of substantive information.

anchors.high: Content is largely filler or repetitive.

rubric.name: Narration Origin
rubric.description: Whether the spoken voice appears human or synthetic.

anchors.human: Voice sounds natural, with human prosody.
anchors.synthetic: Voice has robotic cadence or unnatural tones.

rubric.name: Epistemic Reliability
rubric.description: Confidence that the content is accurate and trustworthy.

anchors.high: Content is well‑sourced and factually accurate.
